summary: Replaced the single-paragraph REVIEW_INSTRUCTION constant in src/goal/plan-autocheck.ts with a structured 5-section version: (1) ROLE — defines the reviewer as an expert plan reviewer with context about executing agent capabilities, (2) POSITIVE CHECKLIST — 6 bullet points for what to verify (file paths, function names, dependency ordering, success criteria specificity, concrete code references, constraint consistency), (3) REJECTION CRITERIA — preserved existing content about fundamental incorrectness plus new rule rejecting 1000+ char step descriptions, (4) APPROVAL CRITERIA — preserved existing content about approving when core steps are correct despite minor environmental assumptions, (5) OUTPUT FORMAT — JSON-only response format. Changed join separator from space to newline for readability. pnpm build and pnpm lint both pass with 0 errors.
